target_customer: Community leaders in smaller Indonesian towns who resell daily goods, and the households that buy from them
problem: Residents outside Indonesia's big cities pay high prices and have poor retail and logistics access; Super lets community leaders run group buying with low-cost supply chains.
business_model: Group-buying social commerce with owned logistics, margin on goods sold (Superagen model)
product_category: Social commerce and grocery group buying

founders.name: Steven Wongsoredjo
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder and CEO by TechCrunch (2021, 2022).

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile commerce app is standard, but low-cost logistics and operations across small cities are hard.

defensibility.rationale: Local community leader networks and logistics are slow to build, but the model was a known copy of Pinduoduo.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; later group-buying rivals KitaBeli, ChiliBeli and Woobiz are named by TechCrunch in 2021.

market_need_then: Large population outside major Indonesian cities underserved by retail; NEA's partner cited 260 million Indonesians outside the capital (via search summary, 2022).

branding.domain_note: Consumer site superapp.id; brand SuperApp belongs to PT Krakatau Karya Abadi per the site footer.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word with heavy confusion with Gojek and other super app talk; no sourced brand press.

outcome_analysis: Super built a community-leader group-buying network in Indonesian smaller cities, raising a 28 million dollar Series B in April 2021 and a 70 million dollar Series C in June 2022, for about 106 million dollars total. It is still listed active with over 1,000 staff per YC; no later round, layoff or exit news was found.
notes: Seed and Series A not found; total raised exceeds 36 million after Series B so earlier funding exists but is unrecorded. Search results name Debeasinta Budiman as a co-founder but no opened source confirms it, so not listed. Competitors: all named rivals come from 2021 sources, too late for the 2018 as_of, so the list is empty. Note the website superapp.id lists a different legal owner, so site may not be the same operating entity as the YC company; unverified. No outcome news after 2022 found.
